title: Sites
sqlForIndicator: select count(s.id) as cnt from Site as s left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id left outer join State as st on g.stateId = st.id left outer join Lga as l on g.lgaId = l.id

title: Devices
sqlForIndicator: select count(d.id) as cnt from Device as d inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join DeviceType as dt on dt.id = d.deviceTypeId inner join DeviceTypeCategory as dc on dc.id = dt.deviceTypeCategoryId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id left outer join State as st on g.stateId = st.id left outer join Lga as l on g.lgaId = l.id where dc.hasResults = 1

title: Results
subTitle: Last 30 Days
sqlForIndicator: select sum(f.resultCount) as cnt from FactResultCountDevice as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where assayId is null and resultCategory1 is null and f.days = 30

title: Contacts
sqlForIndicator: select count(u.id) as cnt from User as u
